writeup: Numskull's First Edition Matrix Neo TUBBZ (model NS5014) is the collectible rubber duck that ships with its own display bathtub. Woot has it for $10.99. Elbenwald currently lists the same First Edition Neo duck in stock at $21, and TUBBZ's US shop wants $24.99, so this price is 47 percent below the lowest verified store, or about $10 less. Woot shows 2 left with a limit of 2 per customer.
